Definition: neuter of a compound of G1223 and a derivative of an alternate of G5342; carried through, i.e. (adverbially with G1519 and G3588 prefixed) perpetually:--+ continually, for ever.
BiblicalUsage: Continually means without ceasing, forever, and Hebrews uses the word four times for what Christ does and what He is. His priesthood continues forever, the sacrifices offered year by year could never make perfect, and by one offering He has perfected forever those who are sanctified.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe continually is the word that separates Christ from every priest before Him. They died and their work ended, but He lives forever, and His one offering keeps working for me without ceasing.
